stem.en: A new disease is spreading among crops. Which field is more likely to have some plants that survive it?

text.en: A field of copies of one plant

feedback.en: Copies share one weakness, so one disease can harm them all.

text.en: A field grown from varied seeds

feedback.en: Yes. The plants differ, so some may resist the disease.

text.en: A field of grafts on one stock

feedback.en: All the scions are one variety, so they share one weakness above the join.

text.en: A field of plantlets from one shoot tip

feedback.en: These plantlets are all genetically identical, so they share one weakness.

explanation.en: Plants grown from seed differ from each other because of mixing in sexual reproduction. Some may be able to resist a new disease.
